search_window.basis: Since the latest verified hourly Care Line watch completion, including previously unrecorded late-reported concrete access decisions; source announcement itself may predate the window.

findings.title: Children’s Home of Kingston to close programs in January
findings.exact_supporting_passage: The facility notified state agencies on Oct. 7 that it would voluntarily close, with a projected date in January.
findings.access_consequences: New York OCFS and Education Department confirmed an October 7 voluntary-closure notification for the 26 Grove Street program, with an anticipated January 2027 closure. About 18 youths in intensive residential treatment and educational programs require continuity planning/alternative placements. Actual closure and specific effective day are not verified. The operator described regulatory work as ongoing.
findings.affected_population: About 18 boys ages 10–22 with trauma, emotional or behavioral challenges in residential and day programs; website describes residential capacity for up to 24 youths.

coverage_notes.scope: Bounded supplementary healthcare-access recall for U.S., DC and territories; authoritative production Care Line collector unchanged.

cms_public_notices.details: No October 24 listings. October 23 My Families Healthcare (CA, 758151), 1ST AIDE HOME HEALTH AGENCY (CA, 559673) and Moonlight Home Health Care Inc (OH, 369006) already in earlier watches.

previous_ledger.intervening_watches: Compared 12:45 and 13:45 watch files identified from branch commit comparison; neither recorded the Kingston closure.

coverage_notes.source_notes: Times Union report dated October 22 confirmed agency notice dated October 7; reporter quotes official NY OCFS and NYSED responses. Provider site independently establishes that residential program delivers intensive therapeutic treatment for youths with trauma, mental illness and behavioral needs. This is a late-reported recall candidate newly found by this check, NOT a newly occurring closure or a definite January effective date.
coverage_notes.exclusions: Discarded old closures (Roseland maternity Oct 31 previously announced Sep 30; September air-medical base loss; old rural hospital and behavioral-unit closures), Greene County IL ambulance funding dispute without enacted access loss, unrelated reopenings and generic scheduled office closures; CMS Oct 23 notices excluded as already logged.
coverage_notes.limitations: One multi-domain local-news search returned robots.txt blocking for wjhl.com; other targeted searches and official CMS worked. DEGRADED rather than FAILED per source/search-failure handling. Exact prior-day article publication time and final program closure day unknown. Bounded search is not comprehensive national monitoring.
coverage_notes.controls: No editorial approval, publication, production collector operation, schedule change, or task disabling.
